$comment: Accessibility debt that lives upstream in the imported component library.
These are WCAG 2.2 AA failures, and M00-08 AC6 requires this gate to block on
one. So each entry below is an *exception* and carries the things an exception
needs: the waiver that owns it in config/quality/waivers.yml, and the date it
stops being acceptable. e2e/gallery.spec.ts fails on any violation not listed
here, fails when a listed one disappears — so the baseline can only shrink —
and fails when a listed one is past its date.
A baseline without a date is a permanent waiver written by whoever was in a
hurry, which is what this file was.
None of these can be fixed in this repository: M00-05 forbids redesigning an
imported component, and patching the vendored copy is drift nobody would ever
reconcile. Each is fixed in gba.dev and re-imported.
Opanel's own pages carry no baseline: e2e/smoke.spec.ts blocks on any

color-contrast.why: Brand palette. destructive #d90429 on #fbe6ea reaches 4.4:1, muted-foreground #727272 on #f3f3f3 reaches 4.33:1, and the inactive tab #848484 reaches 3.37:1 — all below the 4.5:1 that WCAG 2.2 AA requires for body text.
color-contrast.fix: Darken the destructive, muted-foreground and inactive-tab tokens in the gba.dev theme.

aria-input-field-name.why: The library's Slider does not forward aria-label to the Radix thumb, which is the element carrying role=slider. A caller has no way to name it.

scrollable-region-focusable.why: ScrollArea renders the Radix Viewport with a fixed prop set, so tabIndex cannot reach the scrollable element and it is unreachable by keyboard.
scrollable-region-focusable.fix: Spread caller props onto ScrollAreaPrimitive.Viewport, or set tabIndex={0} on it.
